close_reason: Fixed transposed timeout_ms/max_body_bytes args in all 4 domain-guard tests
description:
In crates/smtp/src/mta_sts_fetcher.rs, tests T1-T4 (empty_domain_rejected, domain_with_scheme_rejected, domain_with_path_separator_rejected, domain_with_at_sign_rejected) call fetch_mta_sts_policy_body with arguments in the wrong order.

Signature: fetch_mta_sts_policy_body(client, domain, timeout_ms: u64, max_body_bytes: usize)

Current call: fetch_mta_sts_policy_body(&test_client(), "<domain>", 65_536, 5_000)
  -> timeout_ms = 65_536 ms (65 seconds), max_body_bytes = 5_000 bytes

Correct call: fetch_mta_sts_policy_body(&test_client(), "<domain>", 5_000, 65_536)
  -> timeout_ms = 5_000 ms (5 seconds), max_body_bytes = 65_536 bytes

The tests pass today because all four hit the domain-guard return path before any I/O or body-size check fires, so neither parameter is actually used. However the arguments encode wrong values, and copy-paste of this pattern into any test that reaches the network would produce a 65-second timeout and a 5 KB body cap instead of the intended 5 ms and 64 KB.

Fix: swap the two positional arguments in all four calls.
title: Fix transposed timeout_ms/max_body_bytes args in mta_sts_fetcher tests T1-T4
